name: The Gordunni Scroll

narrative.details: Picking up the soiled scroll, you notice that it seems to be depicting some sort of meeting or ceremony. Rok Orhan would be interested in this scroll, and what it might mean to the Gordunni.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Gordunni Scroll to Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache.
narrative.offerRewardText: This scroll... You found this in the Gordunni Outpost?

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 43 to 47, 7,950 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Bring the Gordunni Orb to Uthel'nay in the Darkbriar Lodge in Orgrimmar.
